messages:
Marta - AE: Newcrest wants a 2-week POC to validate a custom 13B variant + embedding store. They need streaming + 150ms p50 token. Also asked about FedRAMP readiness and customer-managed keys.
Diego - Sales Eng: Do we have the model artifact format? qlora / safetensors / tokenizer?
Marta - AE: Customer said safetensors with LoRA adapter and tokenizer.json included.
Priya - ML Eng: safetensors + LoRA usually fine. Running quick compatibility: checking tokenizer, kv-cache layout, and streaming perf.
DeployBot: Capacity check: region "us-central-poc" shows 2x A100 available.
Priya - ML Eng: Scan: tokenizer loads, 8 OOV tokens to map. Model loads but found one attention op using legacy kernel -> adapter shim needed (~1 day). Streaming tests to follow.
Diego - Sales Eng: Good to note for timeline. Pricing for POC: $4k reserved + $0.70 per 1k tokens above allowance, conditional on adapter work.
Arman - Security: FedRAMP is heavy; for POC we can run Dedicated or Private with BYOK. Need DPA, KMS details, and a basic dataflow diagram. I'll send a short questionnaire.
Marta - AE: I'll ask Newcrest to return DPA + KMS ARN in 4 business days. Also confirm they can sign our minimal FedRAMP POC addendum.
Priya - ML Eng: Opening ticket INF-8281 for adapter & perf matrix. ETA 24-36h for patch + 18h validation.
Diego - Sales Eng: Action items: Marta to collect legal/sec docs, Priya to post INF-8281 updates, I'll prepare provisional quote and kickoff invite.
Marta - AE: Thanks team — I'll update Newcrest and paste replies here.
